1.consolidated_definition: De costo muy reducido o extremadamente barato. A precio de quemazón los árboles de Navidad ante la lenta demanda, en comparación con años anteriores, vendedores los rebajan. (Primera Hora, 17-12-18)
1.en_consolidated_definition: At a very low or extremely cheap price. At prices that are burning them (the trees), Christmas tree sellers are reducing their prices due to slow demand, compared to previous years.
